confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or current listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, since Udaipur hotel rates vary widely by location and property type. July is monsoon off-season, so accommodation anchors reflect lower off-peak rates. Cocktail and wine anchors rely on the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weaker; alcohol prices in India also depend heavily on venue type and high liquor taxes.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Rajasthan tourist cities such as Jaipur and Jodhpur, adjusted for Udaipur's lakeside hotel premium and July monsoon off-season discounts. Cocktail and wine estimates are scaled from the beer anchor, reflecting typical hotel and bar markups in Indian tourist towns.
